description: Urban road network structural robustness and emergency enhancement strategies under rainstorm-waterlogging risk is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Chenxi Li, Yinkun Lei. This dataset contains urban environmental raster data and road network vector data used for analyzing the structural robustness and mitigation strategies of urban road networks under rainstorm–waterlogging risk. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 2450874732 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
